Still in May and the 10,000m championship saw another win for that will o' the whisp Laurie O'Hara, beating Adrian Major into second place by almost three minutes, with one of the old vets, a runner called Gorman (?) getting third.

Lawton, Satchell, Gorman, Pearson and Couzens who worked up to 1am the previous night getting the Hall ready. It was good to see the slim and stylish figure of Eric Hall competing in the Club 3,000 metres walking championship.
As a vet in 1980 he says he will be looking for Gorman and trying to avoid O'Hara. John has now moved to Winnipeg and we wish him, Mavis and their children the best of luck in their new home.
